decisions.reason: The LED supply-voltage and level-shifting decision does not change the existing 3.3V source OR-ing behavior.
The source concerns the power-board-provided 5V LED rail and data-level conversion, not standalone USB operation of the 3.3V rail.
The same source message already has a MODIFY recording LEDs and their logic as loads of the switched 5V boost supply; no additional update or removal is required.
The electrical supply and level-shifting decision does not change how charge status is indicated, its GPIO assignment, or its CHGLED connector circuitry.
The interboard connectors already carry 5V, and the source does not change their connector types, signals, pin-order policy, or numbering.
Adding level conversion between the controller and LEDs does not entail changing any ESP32 GPIO assignment.
The LED power and logic-level decision does not alter the battery connector, battery voltage range, or AXP2101 connection.
The source Event is scoped to the main-board addressable-LED power and logic path and does not explicitly change the separate 16-LED board array's count, type, or electrical interface.
The source does not change the power-board USB-C connector, its data-line support, or its sourceability constraints.
The 5V LED supply and level shifter do not necessarily change the established board dimensions, connector placement, mounting holes, or enclosure-fit constraints.
The source decision is unrelated to battery protection, cutoff behavior, or thermal protection.
The controller-to-LED level shifter is not part of the I2C bus and does not change its speed, pull-ups, cable length, or series resistors.
